description: Side-by-side prices for one service at up to 10 named hospitals (by CMS Certification Number, CCN, from hospital_price_search or hospital_price_coverage). Same fields and same labelling as hospital_price_search: gross charge vs self-pay cash vs payer-negotiated rates, dollar_available on every negotiated rate, and for each hospital that has no price a stated reason (not held and why / code absent / payer not listed). Use for "compare MS-DRG 470 at these three hospitals for Blue Cross".

code.description: The service code: a CPT/HCPCS code from the CMS 70 shoppable services (e.g. "70450" head CT, "45378" colonoscopy, "99213"-style E&M codes only where on that list) or an MS-DRG number (e.g. "470" major joint replacement).

code_type.description: Optional. Inferred when omitted: 1-3 digits is an MS-DRG, a 5-character code is CPT/HCPCS.

payer.description: Case-insensitive substring of the payer name.

plan.description: Case-insensitive substring of the plan name.

setting.description: Restrict to inpatient or outpatient pricing.

name: hospital_price_compare
